---
**PIXEL STUDIO — PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS DOCUMENT**
**Automated Rewards Transparency at Transaction Level**

---

## 1. STRATEGIC CONTEXT

PIXEL's tiered cashback structure (5%/3% up to ₹500 per category, then 1% up to ₹2,000 monthly) generates 2,847+ monthly support tickets due to lack of transaction-level reward visibility, forcing agents to manually calculate and explain tier transitions. Slice has already captured first-mover advantage with instant cashback visibility; delaying beyond Q2 FY25 risks cementing user perception that legacy bank cards lack transparency despite PIXEL's digital-first positioning. PIXEL's existing Zeta Tachyon infrastructure supports real-time transaction processing, making this the fastest path to ticket deflection (60-70% reduction target) with minimal technical risk.

---

## 2. PROBLEM STATEMENT

Users exhaust category-specific ₹500 cashback caps mid-month and receive 1% cashback instead of expected 5%/3%, but have no visibility into why the rate changed, creating confusion and anxiety. Users contact customer support agents who manually calculate category spend and explain tier logic, consuming agent time on repetitive, automatable queries. This opacity undermines trust in PIXEL's rewards promise and generates 2,847+ monthly support tickets tagged "rewards inquiry" or "cashback confusion."

---

## 3. CURRENT STATE

**User Experience:**
- Users receive push notification confirming transaction completion
- PIXEL cashpoints are credited to account instantly post-transaction
- No visibility into cashback percentage applied (5%, 3%, or 1%) at transaction level
- No indication of category-wise cap consumption or remaining eligibility
- Users discover rate changes only when reviewing monthly statements or noticing lower-than-expected cashpoints

**Support Process:**
- User raises ticket: "Why did I get ₹10 cashback instead of ₹50 on my ₹1,000 grocery purchase?"
- Agent manually reviews transaction history, calculates category spend MTD, identifies cap exhaustion
- Agent explains: "You earned ₹500 in Grocery category this month (cap reached), so remaining transactions earn 1%"
- Average handling time: 8-12 minutes per rewards inquiry ticket

**Technical State:**
- Zeta Tachyon platform processes transactions and calculates rewards in real-time
- Rewards engine applies tiered logic correctly (5%/3%/1%) based on category and monthly caps
- No API or UI component exposes calculation logic or cap status to end users
- Transaction detail screen shows only: merchant name, amount, date, total cashpoints earned

**Existing HDFC Credit Cards:**
HDFC Bank's legacy credit card portfolio does not support tiered reward mechanisms; most cards offer flat-rate rewards (e.g., 1% on all spends), eliminating complexity but also differentiation.

---

## 4. COMPETITIVE CONTEXT & DIFFERENTIATION

**Competitive Landscape:**

| Player | Reward Visibility | Implementation |
|--------|------------------|----------------|
| **Slice** (digital-first) | Instant cashback crediting with transaction-level visibility | Cashback credited instantly post-payment with clear communication |
| **HDFC Legacy Cards** | Flat-rate rewards, no tiered complexity | No real-time transparency; monthly statement reconciliation |
| **Other Legacy Banks** | Failed execution on transparent reward communication | Batch processing, delayed visibility, no transaction-level breakdown |

**PIXEL's Chosen Angle: Silent Transparency Engine**

**Why This Angle:**
- Leverages existing Zeta Tachyon real-time processing infrastructure (lowest technical risk)
- Addresses documented customer service burden immediately (2,847 tickets/month)
- Differentiates PIXEL from HDFC's legacy portfolio without requiring new reward structures
- Positions PIXEL as transparency leader among bank-issued cards (Slice is only digital-first competitor with execution)

**Why Now:**
- PIXEL's technical stack already supports real-time transaction processing and push notifications
- First-mover opportunity among bank-issued cards (legacy banks have failed execution)
- Support ticket volume trending upward as user base grows and more users hit category caps

**Whitespace Signal:**
Only Slice has successfully implemented instant reward visibility post-transaction among digital-first competitors. Legacy banks including HDFC's own portfolio lack execution, creating opportunity for PIXEL to lead in transparent, automated reward communication within bank-issued card segment.

---

## 5. REGULATORY REQUIREMENTS

### Mandatory Requirements:
**None identified.** The reviewed excerpts of RBI Master Direction - Credit Card and Debit Card – Issuance and Conduct Directions, 2022 focus on card issuance, activation, unsolicited cards, and card types. No specific mandatory requirements govern rewards program disclosure, real-time transaction-level communications, or cashback calculation displays.

### Advisory/Risk Mitigation Requirements:

**Requirement 1: Accurate Calculation Display**
- **Requirement:** Cashback calculations shown to users must be mathematically accurate and match actual credits to account
- **Source:** General banking accuracy standards (not explicitly found in provided RBI documents)
- **Risk Level:** HIGH
- **Risk if Ignored:** Incorrect rewards display could constitute misrepresentation and trigger consumer complaints under RBI Ombudsman scheme
- **Mitigation:** Implement automated reconciliation between displayed rewards and actual credits; flag discrepancies for manual review within 24 hours

**CRITICAL CAVEAT:** The documents provided are limited excerpts (FAQs and partial sections). A complete review of the full Master Direction and related circulars on rewards programs, customer communication standards, and digital disclosures must be completed before production release.

**Compliance Owner:** Legal & Compliance team to review complete RBI Master Direction before UAT sign-off.

---

## 6. SCOPE

### IN SCOPE:
- Display cashpoints earned on each transaction in transaction detail view
- Show cashback percentage applied (5%, 3%, or 1%) for each transaction
- Display category-wise monthly limit consumption status at transaction level
- Show remaining cashback eligibility in current calendar month per category
- Real-time calculation of rewards tier applied based on category spend
- Transaction-level breakdown showing why specific cashback rate was applied
- Historical transaction rewards visibility (current calendar month only)
- Category identification and display (Dining, Grocery, Entertainment, etc.)
- Monthly cap progress indicators (₹X earned of ₹500 category cap; ₹Y earned of ₹2,000 total cap)

### OUT OF SCOPE:

**Pre-transaction reward estimation:**
- Reason: Requires integration with payment flow and merchant category prediction before transaction authorization; adds complexity and technical risk to MVP. Defer to V2 based on ticket deflection data from post-transaction transparency.

**Predictive reward intelligence / personalized recommendations:**
- Reason: Requires ML infrastructure, data science resources, and 6+ months of user behavior data not currently available. Revisit in FY26 after establishing baseline transparency.

**Cross-month historical rewards analysis (beyond current calendar month):**
- Reason: Adds database query complexity and UI clutter; 90% of support tickets relate to current month confusion. Historical analysis can be added in V2 if user research indicates demand.

**Push notification with rewards breakdown:**
- Reason: Notification fatigue risk; users already receive transaction confirmation push. Defer to V1 after measuring transaction detail screen engagement in MVP.

**Category cap modification or customization:**
- Reason: Rewards structure is product-level decision outside scope of transparency feature. Category caps remain fixed at ₹500 per category, ₹2,000 total monthly.

---

## 7. USER STORIES & ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA

### **User Story 1: View Rewards Earned on Recent Transaction (Happy Path)**
**Priority:** P0  
**Actor:** PIXEL Credit Card User

**As a** PIXEL credit card user  
**I want to** see exactly how many cashpoints I earned on my recent transaction and why  
**So that** I understand my rewards without contacting customer support

**Preconditions:**
- User has active PIXEL credit card
- User has completed at least one transaction in current calendar month
- Transaction has been processed and posted to account
- User has not exceeded ₹2,000 total monthly cashback limit

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**AC1 (Happy Path):**
- **Given** user completed ₹1,000 grocery transaction and has earned ₹200 in Grocery category this month (under ₹500 cap)
- **When** user taps transaction in transaction list and views transaction detail screen
- **Then** system displays:
  - "You earned 50 cashpoints (5%)"
  - "Grocery: ₹250/₹500 earned this month"
  - "Total monthly cashback: ₹250/₹2,000"
  - Category badge: "Grocery"

**AC2 (Tier Transition - Partial Cap Exhaustion):**
- **Given** user has earned ₹480 in Dining category this month (₹20 remaining to cap)
- **When** user completes ₹1,000 dining transaction and views transaction detail
- **Then** system displays:
  - "You earned 30 cashpoints"
  - Breakdown: "₹20 at 5% (₹20 cashpoints) + ₹980 at 1% (₹10 cashpoints) = ₹30 total"
  - "Dining: ₹500/₹500 earned this month (cap reached)"
  - "Total monthly cashback: ₹510/₹2,000"

**AC3 (Post-Cap Transaction):**
- **Given** user has exhausted ₹500 Entertainment category cap
- **When** user completes ₹500 movie ticket transaction and views transaction detail
- **Then** system displays:
  - "You earned 5 cashpoints (1%)"
  - "Entertainment: ₹500/₹500 earned this month (cap reached)"
  - "Remaining transactions in Entertainment earn 1% cashback"
  - "Total monthly cashback: ₹505/₹2,000"

**AC4 (Total Monthly Cap Reached):**
- **Given** user has earned ₹2,000 total cashback this month across all categories
- **When** user completes any transaction and views transaction detail
- **Then** system displays:
  - "You earned 0 cashpoints"
  - "Monthly cashback limit reached: ₹2,000/₹2,000"
  - "Limit resets on [1st of next month]"
  - All category caps show as inactive/greyed out

**AC5 (Failure State - Calculation Mismatch):**
- **Given** displayed cashpoints do not match actual credited cashpoints (system detects discrepancy)
- **When** user views transaction detail screen
- **Then** system displays:
  - "Cashback calculation in progress. Final amount will reflect within 24 hours."
  - Logs error to monitoring system with transaction ID, displayed amount, credited amount
  - Triggers alert to Ops team for manual reconciliation
  - User sees "Report Issue" CTA linking to support ticket with pre-filled transaction details

---

### **User Story 2: Understand Category-Specific Cap Status**
**Priority:** P0  
**Actor:** PIXEL Credit Card User

**As a** PIXEL credit card user  
**I want to** see how much cashback I've earned in each category this month  
**So that** I can understand when I'll transition from 5%/3% to 1% cashback

**Preconditions:**
- User has active PIXEL credit card
- User has completed at least one transaction in a preferred category (5% or 3%) in current calendar month

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**AC1 (Multiple Categories Active):**
- **Given** user has earned ₹300 in Grocery (5%), ₹150 in Dining (5%), ₹50 in Entertainment (3%)
- **When** user views any transaction detail screen
- **Then** system displays category summary section:
  - "Grocery: ₹300/₹500 (5% active)"
  - "Dining: ₹150/₹500 (5% active)"
  - "Entertainment: ₹50/₹500 (3% active)"
  - "Other: ₹0 (1% always)"
  - "Total monthly: ₹500/₹2,000"

**AC2 (Category Cap Visual Indicator):**
- **Given** user has earned ₹450 in Grocery category (90% of cap)
- **When** user views transaction detail screen
- **Then** system displays:
  - Progress bar showing 90% filled for Grocery category
  - "₹50 remaining at 5%" label
  - Visual warning indicator (amber color) when >80% of category cap consumed

**AC3 (New Calendar Month Reset):**
- **Given** user earned ₹500 in Grocery category in previous month (cap exhausted)
- **When** calendar month changes to new month and user views transaction detail
- **Then** system displays:
  - "Grocery: ₹0/₹500 (5% active)"
  - "All category caps reset on [date]"
  - Previous month's data not visible in transaction detail view

**AC4 (Failure State - Category Misclassification):**
- **Given** merchant MCC code is ambiguous or miscategorized
- **When** user views transaction detail and category appears incorrect
- **Then** system displays:
  - Detected category with "Report Issue" CTA
  - User can submit category correction request
  - Ticket auto-created with transaction ID, merchant name, detected category, user-suggested category
  - Disclaimer: "Category corrections may take 3-5 business days. Cashback rate will be adjusted if approved."

---

### **User Story 3: Access Rewards Breakdown from Transaction List**
**Priority:** P1  
**Actor:** PIXEL Credit Card User

**As a** PIXEL credit card user  
**I want to** quickly see cashpoints earned without opening full transaction detail  
**So that** I can scan my recent transactions efficiently

**Preconditions:**
- User has active PIXEL credit card
- User has completed at least one transaction in current calendar month

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**AC1 (Transaction List View):**
- **Given** user is viewing transaction list (home screen or transactions tab)
- **When** transaction list loads
- **Then** each transaction row displays:
  - Merchant name
  - Transaction amount
  - Cashpoints earned (e.g., "+50 cashpoints")
  - Cashback percentage badge (5%, 3%, or 1%)
  - Date

**AC2 (Tap to Expand):**
- **Given** user is viewing transaction list
- **When** user taps on any transaction row
- **Then** system navigates to full transaction detail screen (User Story 1)

**AC3 (Zero Cashback Indicator):**
- **Given** user has reached ₹2,000 monthly cap
- **When** user views transaction list
- **Then** transactions after cap show:
  - "0 cashpoints" in greyed-out text
  - "Monthly limit reached" label

**AC4 (Failure State - Rewards Pending):**
- **Given** transaction is posted but rewards calculation is delayed (system processing lag)
- **When** user views transaction list
- **Then** transaction row displays:
  - "Cashback pending" label
  - Spinner icon
  - Tapping row shows "Calculation in progress" message in detail view

---

### **User Story 4: View Monthly Cashback Summary Dashboard**
**Priority:** P2 (Defer to V1)  
**Actor:** PIXEL Credit Card User

**As a** PIXEL credit card user  
**I want to** see a consolidated view of all my category caps and monthly progress  
**So that** I can plan my spending to maximize rewards

**Preconditions:**
- User has active PIXEL credit card
- User has completed at least one transaction in current calendar month

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**AC1 (Dashboard Access):**
- **Given** user is on PIXEL app home screen
- **When** user taps "Rewards" or "Cashback Summary" CTA
- **Then** system navigates to monthly cashback dashboard

**AC2 (Dashboard Content):**
- **Given** user has earned cashback across multiple categories
- **When** dashboard loads
- **Then** system displays:
  - Total monthly cashback: "₹X/₹2,000"
  - Category-wise breakdown with progress bars:
    - Grocery: ₹X/₹500 (5%)
    - Dining: ₹X/₹500 (5%)
    - Entertainment: ₹X/₹500 (3%)
  - "Days remaining in month: X"
  - "Next reset date: [date]"
  - List of recent transactions contributing to each category (last 5 per category)

**AC3 (Failure State - Data Load Error):**
- **Given** backend API fails to return dashboard data
- **When** user accesses dashboard
- **Then** system displays:
  - "Unable to load rewards summary. Please try again."
  - Retry CTA
  - Fallback: "View transaction history" CTA linking to transaction list

### User Metrics:

| **Transaction detail screen engagement** | 23% of users view details within 24hrs of transaction | 45% of users view details within 24hrs | 30 days post-launch | Product Analytics |
| **Rewards section interaction rate** | N/A (new feature) | >60% of users who view transaction detail interact with rewards breakdown | 30 days post-launch | Product Analytics |
| **Time spent on transaction detail screen** | Avg 8 seconds | Avg 15-20 seconds (indicates engagement with rewards info) | 30 days post-launch | Product Analytics |
| **"Report Issue" CTA usage (rewards)** | N/A | <2% of transaction detail views (low = clarity achieved) | 60 days post-launch | Product Analytics |

### Bank Metrics:

| Metric | Baseline | Target | Timeframe | Owner |
|--------|----------|--------|-----------|-------|
| **Rewards calculation accuracy** | Unknown (no current monitoring) | 100% match between displayed and credited cashpoints | Ongoing from Day 1 | Engineering + Ops |
| **Rewards reconciliation discrepancies** | Manual reconciliation on complaint basis | 0 discrepancies requiring manual intervention | 30 days post-launch | Operations |

## 9. ROLLOUT STRATEGY

### **MVP (Month 1)**
**What Ships:**
- Transaction detail screen shows cashpoints earned and cashback percentage (5%, 3%, 1%)
- Category identification and display (Grocery, Dining, Entertainment, Other)
- Category-wise cap consumption status: "₹X/₹500 earned this month"
- Total monthly cap status: "₹Y/₹2,000 earned this month"
- Basic tier transition logic display: "₹A at 5% + ₹B at 1% = ₹C total" for partial cap exhaustion

**Rollout:**
- **Week 1-2:** 10% of user base (random selection, stratified by transaction frequency)
- **Week 3:** 25% of user base
- **Week 4:** 60% of user base
- **Week 5:** 100% of user base

**Success Gate (to proceed to 25%):**
- Calculation accuracy: >99.5% match between displayed and credited cashpoints
- Support ticket volume: No increase in rewards-related tickets among 10% cohort
- App stability: <0.2% crash rate on transaction detail screen
- User engagement: >40% of 10% cohort views transaction detail within 24hrs of transaction

**Kill Switch Condition:**
- Calculation mismatch rate >1%
- Support ticket spike >20% week-over-week
- App crash rate >0.5% on transaction detail screen
- Critical bug: incorrect category cap display (e.g., showing ₹600/₹500)

**CS Readiness:**
- FAQ documentation: "Understanding Your Cashback Breakdown" (5 FAQs max)
- Agent training: 1-hour session on new UI, how to troubleshoot calculation mismatches
- Escalation path: Engineering on-call for calculation discrepancies (SLA: 4 hours response)

---

### **V1 (Month 3-4)**
**What Ships (in addition to MVP):**
- Monthly cashback summary dashboard (consolidated view of all categories)
- Progress bars for category caps with visual warnings at >80% consumption
- "Report Issue" CTA for category misclassification or calculation disputes
- Push notification enhancement: "You earned X cashpoints on your recent purchase" (optional, based on MVP engagement data)
- Historical transaction rewards visibility (current month only, filterable by category)

**Rollout:**
- **Week 1:** 25% of user base
- **Week 2:** 60% of user base
- **Week 3:** 100% of user base

**Success Gate (to proceed to 60%):**
- MVP metrics sustained: >99.5% calculation accuracy, >45% transaction detail engagement
- Dashboard engagement: >30% of users access monthly summary dashboard at least once per month
- "Report Issue" usage: <2% of transaction detail views (indicates clarity)
- Support ticket reduction: >50% reduction vs. pre-MVP baseline

**Kill Switch Condition:**
- Same as MVP
- Dashboard load time >3 seconds (performance degradation)

**CS Readiness:**
- Updated FAQ: Add dashboard navigation, category correction process
- Agent training: 30-minute refresher on dashboard features, category dispute resolution workflow

---

### **V2 (Month 6+, Pending V1 Success)**
**What Ships (in addition to V1):**
- Pre-transaction reward estimation: "This ₹1,000 transaction will earn approximately X cashpoints"
- Predictive insights: "You have ₹50 remaining in Dining category. Spend by [date] to maximize 5% cashback."
- Cross-month historical analysis: View rewards earned in previous calendar months
- Category spend trends: "You've earned 20% more in Grocery this month vs. last month"

**Rollout:**
- Phased rollout: 10% → 50% → 100% over 4 weeks

**Success Gate:**
- V1 metrics sustained
- Pre-transaction estimation accuracy: >95% match between estimated and actual cashpoints
- User engagement with predictive insights: >20% of users act on recommendations

**Kill Switch Condition:**
- Pre-transaction estimation accuracy <90%
- Predictive insights cause user confusion (measured by support ticket increase)

**CS Readiness:**
- Comprehensive FAQ update: Pre-transaction estimates, predictive insights
- Agent training: 1-hour session on V2 features, handling estimation discrepancies

---

## 10. CUSTOMER SUPPORT & OPERATIONS

### Customer Support Impact:

**New Ticket Types:**

1. **"Cashback calculation doesn't match displayed amount"**
   - **SLA:** 24 hours (P1 - financial impact)
   - **Routing:** Tier 2 → Engineering escalation if calculation error confirmed
   - **Resolution:** Manual reconciliation, credit adjustment if bank error, explanation if user misunderstanding
   - **Training Need:** Agents must understand tier transition logic, category cap mechanics, calendar month reset timing

2. **"Wrong category assigned to transaction"**
   - **SLA:** 3-5 business days (P2 - non-urgent)
   - **Routing:** Tier 1 → Ops team for MCC review
   - **Resolution:** Category correction if valid, cashback adjustment if rate changes, explanation if MCC is correct
   - **Training Need:** Agents must understand MCC-to-category mapping, when corrections are possible vs. not

3. **"Why did my cashback rate change mid-month?"**
   - **SLA:** 4 hours (P2 - informational)
   - **Routing:** Tier 1 (deflectable via in-app explanation)
   - **Resolution:** Agent walks user through transaction detail screen, explains cap exhaustion
   - **Training Need:** Agents must be able to replicate user's transaction history view, explain tier transitions clearly

**Ticket Deflection Strategy:**

| Current Ticket Driver | Deflection Mechanism | Expected Reduction |
|-----------------------|----------------------|-------------------|
| "Why did I get 1% instead of 5%?" | Transaction detail shows cap exhaustion + remaining eligibility | 70% |
| "How much cashback have I earned this month?" | Monthly dashboard shows total + category breakdown | 80% |
| "When does my cashback reset?" | Transaction detail + dashboard show reset date | 90% |
| "Which category is this merchant?" | Transaction detail shows category badge | 60% |
| "Did I get the right cashback amount?" | Transaction detail shows calculation breakdown | 50% |

**Overall Expected Ticket Reduction:** 60-70% of 2,847 monthly tickets = 1,708-1,993 tickets deflected = **1,139-854 residual tickets/month**

**Agent Training Requirements:**
- **Pre-launch (1 week before MVP):** 2-hour training session covering:
  - PIXEL rewards structure refresher (5%/3%/1% tiers, category caps, monthly cap)
  - New transaction detail UI walkthrough
  - How to troubleshoot calculation mismatches (step-by-step)
  - Escalation paths for calculation errors vs. category disputes
  - FAQ responses for top 5 anticipated questions
- **V1 launch:** 1-hour refresher on dashboard features, category correction workflow
- **Ongoing:** Monthly review of new ticket patterns, FAQ updates

**CS Readiness Score:** 6/10 (improved from 4/10 with training plan and escalation paths defined)

---

### Operations Impact:

**Manual Touchpoints Eliminated:**
1. **Manual cashback calculation for user inquiries:** Agents currently spend 8-12 minutes per ticket manually reviewing transaction history, calculating category spend MTD, and explaining tier logic. This is fully automated by transaction detail screen.
2. **Manual reconciliation on user complaint basis:** Ops currently reconciles displayed vs. credited cashpoints only when user complains. New feature enables proactive monitoring via automated discrepancy detection.

**New Processes Required:**

1. **Automated Reconciliation (Daily)**
   - **Process:** Nightly batch job compares displayed cashpoints (logged at transaction detail view) vs. credited cashpoints (from Zeta Tachyon)
   - **Output:** Discrepancy report flagging transactions where displayed ≠ credited
   - **Owner:** Operations team
   - **SLA:** Review and resolve discrepancies within 24 hours
   - **Escalation:** Engineering if systemic calculation error detected (>10 discrepancies/day)

2. **Category Correction Workflow**
   - **Trigger:** User submits "Report Issue" for category misclassification
   - **Process:** 
     - Ops reviews merchant MCC code and transaction details
     - If correction valid: Update merchant-category mapping, recalculate cashback, credit difference
     - If MCC is correct: Respond to user explaining category assignment logic
   - **Owner:** Operations team
   - **SLA:** 3-5 business days
   - **Volume Estimate:** <2% of transaction detail views = ~500 requests/month (assuming 25,000 transactions/month, 45% detail view rate)

3. **Calculation Error Escalation**
   - **Trigger:** Automated reconciliation flags systemic error (>10 discrepancies/day) OR agent escalates calculation mismatch
   - **Process:**
     - Ops creates P0 incident ticket for Engineering
     - Engineering investigates root cause (API issue, rewards engine bug, data sync lag)
     - If confirmed bug: Immediate fix + backfill incorrect cashpoints for affected users
     - If data sync lag: Monitor and resolve within 24 hours
   - **Owner:** Engineering (on-call rotation)
   - **SLA:** 4 hours response, 24 hours resolution

**Ops Readiness Requirements:**
- **Pre-launch:** Set up automated reconciliation job, test discrepancy detection logic
- **Training:** 1-hour session on category correction workflow, escalation paths
- **Tooling:** Admin panel to view discrepancy reports, approve category corrections, trigger cashback adjustments

---

## 11. REPORTS & RECONCILIATION

### Existing Reports (No Changes Required):
- **Monthly Rewards Issued Report:** Existing report tracks total cashpoints issued per user, per category, per month. No changes needed; this feature only adds transparency, not new reward logic.
- **Transaction-Level Rewards Report:** Existing report logs transaction ID, user ID, amount, category, cashback %, cashpoints issued. No schema changes required.

### New Reports Required:

**Report 1: Rewards Display Accuracy Report (Daily)**
- **Purpose:** Monitor calculation accuracy between displayed and credited cashpoints
- **Frequency:** Daily (automated)
- **Owner:** Operations team
- **Data Points:**
  - Transaction ID
  - User ID
  - Displayed cashpoints (logged when user views transaction detail)
  - Credited cashpoints (from Zeta Tachyon)
  - Discrepancy amount (displayed - credited)
  - Discrepancy % (discrepancy / credited)
  - Transaction date
  - Category
  - Cashback % applied
- **Filters:** Date range, discrepancy threshold (>₹1), category, user ID
- **Output Format:** CSV export, Ops dashboard view
- **Alerting:** Email alert to Ops + Engineering if >10 discrepancies detected in single day

**Report 2: Transaction Detail Engagement Report (Weekly)**
- **Purpose:** Measure user engagement with rewards transparency feature
- **Frequency:** Weekly
- **Owner:** Product Analytics team
- **Data Points:**
  - Total transactions
  - Transaction detail views (count, % of total transactions)
  - Rewards section interactions (expand/collapse, tap category, tap "Report Issue")
  - Time spent on transaction detail screen (avg, median, p90)
  - Users who viewed detail within 24hrs of transaction (count, %)
- **Segmentation:** By user cohort (10%, 25%, 60%, 100% rollout), transaction frequency (low/med/high), category
- **Output Format:** Dashboard (Looker/Tableau), weekly email summary to Product + CS leadership

**Report 3: Category Correction Request Report (Weekly)**
- **Purpose:** Track category misclassification issues, identify merchant mapping gaps
- **Frequency:** Weekly
- **Owner:** Operations team
- **Data Points:**
  - Request ID
  - User ID
  - Transaction ID
  - Merchant name
  - Detected category
  - User-suggested category
  - MCC code
  - Request status (pending, approved, rejected)
  - Resolution date
  - Cashback adjustment amount (if approved)
- **Filters:** Date range, status, category, merchant
- **Output Format:** CSV export, Ops dashboard view
- **Insights:** Identify merchants with high correction request rates → update merchant-category mapping proactively

### Reconciliation Requirements:

**Daily Reconciliation:**
- **Process:** Automated nightly batch job (runs at 2 AM IST)
- **Logic:** 
  - Query all transactions from previous day where user viewed transaction detail (event: `zcrw_transaction_detail_rewards_viewed`)
  - Extract displayed cashpoints from event properties
  - Query Zeta Tachyon API for credited cashpoints for same transaction IDs
  - Compare displayed vs. credited
  - Flag discrepancies where |displayed - credited| > ₹1 OR discrepancy % > 5%
- **Output:** Discrepancy report (Report 1) + email alert if >10 discrepancies
- **Manual Review:** Ops reviews flagged transactions, investigates root cause, escalates to Engineering if systemic issue

**Monthly Reconciliation:**
- **Process:** Manual review by Ops team (first week of each month)
- **Logic:**
  - Compare total cashpoints issued (from existing Monthly Rewards Issued Report)
